candidates.name: Margaret Ellison
candidates.bio: Two-term state senator and former state appellate judge. Has focused on healthcare costs, rural hospitals and water infrastructure.

candidates.name: Daniel Ruiz-Whitaker
candidates.bio: Third-generation rancher and former county judge who served eight years in the state House. Campaigning on border security and lower taxes.

candidates.name: Priya Natarajan
candidates.bio: Founder of a 30-person software firm, making her first run for office on cutting federal spending and protecting civil liberties.

candidates.name: Caleb Brooks
candidates.bio: Army veteran and owner of a regional roofing company; served one term on the city council.

candidates.name: Alicia Moreno
candidates.bio: Pediatric ICU nurse for 15 years and former nurses’ union organizer, running on healthcare affordability.

candidates.name: Grant Holloway
candidates.bio: Former CFO of a regional bank, running without a party on deficit reduction and term limits.

candidates.name: Raymond Teague
candidates.bio: Former two-term lieutenant governor and oil-field services executive. Emphasizes property-tax relief and energy production.

candidates.name: Danielle Okafor
candidates.bio: Former big-city mayor and public-school teacher. Emphasizes public-school funding and expanding healthcare access.

candidates.name: Rosa Lindqvist
candidates.bio: Environmental engineer and watershed advocate focused on grid reliability and clean water.

candidates.name: Wesley Park
candidates.bio: Family physician and former school-board trustee. Prioritizes rural healthcare and school safety.

candidates.name: Hannah Cole
candidates.bio: Small-business attorney and former chamber of commerce chair, running as a pro-business moderate.

candidates.name: Luke Barrett
candidates.bio: Pastor and director of a food-assistance nonprofit; first-time candidate.

candidates.name: Simone Fairchild
candidates.bio: High-school counselor and PTA leader focused on teacher pay and mental-health services.

candidates.name: Gary Whitfield
candidates.bio: Incumbent commissioner and former road-and-bridge supervisor. Running on holding the county tax rate flat.

candidates.name: Teresa Alvarado
candidates.bio: CPA and former assistant county auditor, focused on jail costs and budget transparency.

candidates.name: Marcus Bell
candidates.bio: Youth pastor and parent of three district students. Campaigning on parental rights and school safety.

candidates.name: Jenna Kowalski
candidates.bio: Retired district science teacher with 28 years in the classroom; focused on teacher retention.

candidates.name: Andrea Shah
candidates.bio: Engineer and PTA president; running on academic results and budget discipline.

candidates.name: Benjamin Okoro
candidates.bio: Owner of two local restaurants; focused on small-business permitting and road repair.

candidates.name: Laura Jennings
candidates.bio: Realtor and current planning commissioner; prioritizes lower property taxes and police staffing.

candidates.name: Victor Hale
candidates.bio: Urban planner focused on parks, transit and energy-efficient city buildings.
